esqlQuery.esql:
FROM chargeback_lookup.billing_cluster_cost
| EVAL threshold_spend = 200.0, filter_deployment = "*", filter_category = "*"
| WHERE @timestamp IS NOT NULL AND deployment_id IS NOT NULL
| INLINE STATS latest_day = MAX(@timestamp) BY deployment_id
| WHERE @timestamp == latest_day
| EVAL ts = @timestamp
| EVAL is_onprem_row = COALESCE(is_onprem, ess.billing.deployment_type IN ("onprem", "ece", "eck") OR cloud.provider == "onprem", false), cloud_cfg_key = "chargeback_config"
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.chargeback_conf ON cloud_cfg_key == config_join_key AND ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| EVAL cloud_rate = conf_chargeable_unit_rate, cloud_unit = conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit, cloud_sym = conf_currency_symbol
| DROP cloud_cfg_key, config_join_key, conf_start_date, conf_end_date, conf_chargeable_unit_rate, conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit, conf_currency_symbol
| EVAL onprem_cfg_key = CASE(is_onprem_row, "chargeback_config_onprem", null)
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.chargeback_conf ON onprem_cfg_key == config_join_key AND ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| EVAL rate = CASE(is_onprem_row, COALESCE(conf_chargeable_unit_rate, 0.00085), COALESCE(cloud_rate, 0.85)),
       unit = CASE(is_onprem_row, COALESCE(CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit)), null), CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(cloud_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(cloud_unit)), null), "EUR"), COALESCE(CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(cloud_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(cloud_unit)), null), "EUR")),
       currency_symbol = CASE(is_onprem_row, COALESCE(CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(conf_currency_symbol)) > 0, TRIM(conf_currency_symbol), null), CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(cloud_sym)) > 0, TRIM(cloud_sym), null), "€"), COALESCE(CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(cloud_sym)) > 0, TRIM(cloud_sym), null), "€"))
| EVAL units = COALESCE(total_chargeable_units, 0.0)
| EVAL cost = units * rate
| EVAL deployment = COALESCE(deployment_name, deployment_id, "unknown")
| EVAL dep_group = CASE(deployment_group IS NOT NULL AND deployment_group != "", deployment_group, null)
| EVAL category_label = COALESCE(cost_category, "other")
| EVAL day = LEFT(TO_STRING(ts), 10)
| WHERE (filter_deployment == "*" OR deployment == filter_deployment OR deployment_id == filter_deployment)
    AND (filter_category == "*" OR category_label == filter_category)
| EVAL data_tier_c = CASE(category_label IN ("data_tier", "onprem"), cost, 0.0),
       platform_c = CASE(category_label == "platform", cost, 0.0),
       transfer_c = CASE(category_label == "transfer", cost, 0.0),
       snapshot_c = CASE(category_label == "snapshot", cost, 0.0)
| STATS
    spend = ROUND(SUM(cost), 2),
    units_total = ROUND(SUM(units), 2),
    data_tier_spend = ROUND(SUM(data_tier_c), 2),
    platform_spend = ROUND(SUM(platform_c), 2),
    transfer_spend = ROUND(SUM(transfer_c), 2),
    snapshot_spend = ROUND(SUM(snapshot_c), 2),
    threshold = MAX(threshold_spend),
    sym = COALESCE(MAX(currency_symbol), "€"),
    dep_group = MAX(dep_group),
    unit = COALESCE(MAX(unit), "EUR")
  BY day, deployment, deployment_id
| EVAL dep_group = COALESCE(dep_group, "ungrouped")
| WHERE spend > threshold
| SORT spend DESC
| EVAL result = CONCAT("[", day, "] Deployment `", deployment, "` (", deployment_id, ", group=", dep_group, ") daily spend of ", sym, TO_STRING(spend), " ", unit, " (", TO_STRING(units_total), " units; data_tier=", sym, TO_STRING(data_tier_spend), ", platform=", sym, TO_STRING(platform_spend), ", transfer=", sym, TO_STRING(transfer_spend), ", snapshot=", sym, TO_STRING(snapshot_spend), ") exceeded threshold of ", sym, TO_STRING(threshold), " ", unit, ".")
| KEEP result, day, deployment, deployment_id, dep_group, spend, units_total, data_tier_spend, platform_spend, transfer_spend, snapshot_spend, threshold, unit
